subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Telegram-specific `unknownGroupAction` config surface now, or keep this work in the broader group-pairing/security design path?
rationale: The PR adds fail-closed operator behavior in a channel authorization boundary; code fixes are mechanical, but the permanent config/API direction needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor after repairs
options.body: Accept the Telegram-specific config direction only after the authorization/threading findings, docs, conflict, and live proof are addressed.

options.title: Defer to canonical design
options.body: Keep the desired behavior tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50681 or the broader pairing work and close this PR after preserving useful notes.

options.title: Narrow to tests/proof only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that proves current group-policy behavior without adding the new config surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the Telegram-specific config direction only after the authorization/threading findings, docs, conflict, and live proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: He appears in recent Telegram/plugin seam history and is the best available routing candidate for product/API direction among the likely owners.
